decisive_items: palmar IP creases had ulcerated lichenoid papules
Follow-up Chest CT revealed worsening interstitial lung disease
response.rationale: The ulcerated palmar-crease lichenoid papules, dorsal MCP ulcers, elevated ferritin, lymphopenia, and amyopathic muscle/CK pattern with worsening restrictive ILD strongly favor clinically amyopathic dermatomyositis (anti-MDA5 phenotype), more than SLE or primary APS.

rejected.why: Overlapping anti-SSA, lymphopenia, arthritis, and alopecia can suggest SLE, but the specific palmar/dorsal ulceropapular hand lesions and amyopathic high-ferritin ILD pattern are characteristic of dermatomyositis.

Positive anticardiolipin and dermal fibrin thrombi can accompany connective-tissue disease, but no confirmed major thrombosis or sustained antiphospholipid criteria are present; these findings are secondary features.
